simple.meaning: לוּחִית (Lûwchîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Luchith , a place East of the Jordan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לוּחִית (H3872) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 15:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּחִית (H3872) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לוּחִית (H3872) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לוּחִית (Lûwchîyth) / H3872 is traced through Isaiah 15:5, Jeremiah 48:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Luchith , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3872. Luchith or Luchoth הלחות Jer 48:5 Kt see לוּחִית . לוּחִית proper name, of a location in Moab; with article מַעֲלֵה הַלּוּחִית Isa 15:5 ; Jer 48:5 Qr ( הַלֻּחִית ; Kt. הלחות ); it lay south of the Arnon; compare Buhl Geogr. 24, 272 and references ; ᵐ5 Λουειθ .
definitions.rootNote: or לֻחוֹת ; (Jeremiah 48:5), from the same as 3871 ; floored ;

occurrences.englishText: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
